dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: Yeah, I run a tailor shop that's well-liked by the locals.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: Business has been good, but... I'm not satisfied with my tailoring skills.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: My regular customers just praise the clothes I make all the time, and when I ask them if they have any suggestions for me, they all say that they don't have any.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: The number of dressmaking techniques that could be learned from the Akasha were very limited, and customer suggestions are nowhere to be sought...

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: The way things are going, I'll never improve my fashion design skills!

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: That's why I've recently been considering going to Fontaine for further training. I've heard that there are some very good couture stores.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: ...On the other hand, I've also heard that Fontaine produces mostly machine-made clothing, which means that they hardly need craftsmen. What should I do...?
